summary: Umatilla Indian Reservation site 19 miles east of Pendleton: a 1930s tower now gone and listed as abandoned, administered by BIA, registered 2019 with no exact build year.

facts.agency: Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA), per the register

events.note: Register and firelookout.com give only the 1930s. The year 1930 is carried over from the brief; no source states it, so the decade-only proposal in corrections is for human review
Registered November 19, 2019 as US 1836, OR 559; nominated by Tammy McLeod

evidence.supports: a tower was constructed on the site in the 1930s and is gone
evidence.quote: A tower was constructed on the site in the 1930's and is gone.

evidence.supports: tower dated to the 1930s and listed as abandoned
site is 19 miles east of Pendleton in Umatilla County, Oregon
site is in Umatilla County, Oregon
the register lists BIA as administering agency
site lies within the Umatilla Indian Reservation
firelookout.com lists the site on the Umatilla Indian Reservation

corrections.proposed: 1930s (decade only; no exact year in the sources)
corrections.why: The register's Built field reads 1930's and its description says the tower was constructed in the 1930's. No source gives 1930 exactly.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: three sources, two of which are short directory entries, and no source describes the site today. The brief's access 'permission' is not stated by any source we read, so access is not changed; the editor should decide whether to keep it. The brief's built year 1930 is stated by no source; the correction proposes the decade. Two searches turned up no further history.
